title: No penalty for Maatsen's reckless challenge on Guimarães
summary: In the eighth minute of added time, Ian Maatsen, already on a yellow, caught Bruno Guimarães' standing leg without touching the ball. Jarred Gillett played on and VAR did not recommend a review. The KMI panel ruled 5-0 that it was a penalty and a second yellow. Arsenal won 1-0 through Saka regardless.
consequences: The KMI panel also ruled that Maatsen should have received a second yellow card.
